name: workstream
description: Workstream hooks, a badge naming the attached workstream and this session's role, and a side pane with its frontier

badge.title: Workstream badge
badge.description: "status" (default): a pinned status line, which Claude Code draws as a yellow warning. "band": a one-row badge in the band above the prompt, in quieter colors. "off": no badge; the pane and hooks still work.
